Rule: Go CLI named lem-in reads one file argument
Evidence: Build executable; test zero/one/two arguments and a missing file.

Rule: Only standard Go packages in assessed implementations
Evidence: Inspect go.mod and imports; go list -deps shows only own module and standard library.

Rule: Echo accepted input before movements
Evidence: Compare normalized original bytes to transcript prefix, including comments and commands.

Rule: Movement tokens L<number>-<room>, one line per turn
Evidence: Black-box transcript parser; reject malformed tokens and extra diagnostics.

Rule: All numbered ants start at start and finish at end
Evidence: Independent complete replay with exactly n stable ant identities.

Rule: Finish in the fewest turns
Evidence: Correspondence proof, monotone deadline search, T-1 cut/BFS bound and independent tiny oracle.

Rule: Ordinary rooms hold at most one ant; terminals unlimited
Evidence: Collision mutations and room-split model tests; concurrent arrivals at end allowed.

Rule: Each undirected tunnel used at most once per turn
Evidence: Opposing-swap and direct-edge multi-ant tests; shared gadget bottleneck.

Rule: Each ant moves at most once and only to an adjacent room
Evidence: Duplicate-ID and nonedge movement mutations.

Rule: Receiving room must be available; pipelines supported
Evidence: Vacated-room pipeline accepted, stationary-room collision rejected.

Rule: Rooms use name x y; names need not be numeric or ordered
Evidence: Unordered numeric/nonnumeric names; canonical identity independent from coordinates.

Rule: Names cannot begin with L or # and contain no spaces
Evidence: Invalid-prefix/whitespace tests and valid UTF-8/hyphen names.

Rule: Coordinates are integers and serve the bonus
Evidence: Signed/overflow tests; path costs ignore coordinates; safe render transform.

Rule: Tunnels join exactly two known rooms
Evidence: Unknown endpoint, malformed and ambiguous endpoint cases.

Rule: No duplicate rooms or duplicate undirected tunnels
Evidence: Duplicate name and reversed edge fixtures.

Rule: Invalid counts, terminals and malformed input produce errors
Evidence: Grammar mutation table with deliberate stream/exit results.

Rule: Self-links are invalid; ordinary cycles terminate safely
Evidence: Self-link rejection and cyclic valid graph acceptance.

Rule: No route is an error; disconnected extras are handled
Evidence: Unreachable end rejected; isolated irrelevant component leaves optimum unchanged.

Rule: Ignore unknown commands
Evidence: Unknown commands before count, during pending marker and after links; echo preserved.

Rule: ERROR: invalid data format with optional suffix; no unexpected crash
Evidence: Fuzz/adversarial inputs, exact prefix and no accepted partial colony.

Rule: Good practices and meaningful tests
Evidence: gofmt, vet, modular errors, enabled behavior tests, mutation and fuzz evidence.

Rule: Published example turn ceilings and timing cases
Evidence: Examples 00..05 ceilings 6,8,11,6,6,8; 06/07 measured below 90/150 seconds.

Rule: Explicit grammar phases and terminal binding
Evidence: Transition-table coverage and pending-marker tests.

Rule: Hyphenated endpoint names use unique known-name split
Evidence: Unique split accepted; ambiguous four-name fixture rejected.

Rule: LF/CRLF normalization and exact echo separator
Evidence: Byte comparison with missing-final-LF, comments and unknown commands.

Rule: Batch departures before arrivals; token order does not define legality
Evidence: Pipeline token permutation and documented rotation semantics.

Rule: Deterministic graph, trajectory IDs and ID-sorted tokens
Evidence: Canonical name/edge ordering and 20 byte-identical runs.

Rule: Checked size/work limits; resource errors do not mean infeasible
Evidence: Boundary arithmetic, low-budget refusal and no greedy fallback.

Rule: Independent movement validator and optimality evidence
Evidence: 3294 tiny graph/ant comparisons plus targeted larger greedy trap and invariant mutations.

Rule: Typed process outcomes: streams and exit statuses
Evidence: Success=0; invalid/no-route stdout=1; usage/I/O stderr=2; resource stderr=3.

Rule: Ant allocation and concurrent pipeline scheduling
Evidence: Fixed-route capacity formula, extraction, waits and legal completion.

Rule: Complexity and bounded handling documented honestly
Evidence: Model-size formulas, capped flow bound, output cost and measured performance.

Rule: Optional visualizer consumes solver stdout
Evidence: Go-native producer/consumer test; invalid/truncated stream rejected.

Rule: Go-only standard-library animated GIF with coordinates
Evidence: GIF decode-back, viewed motion, no graphics/font dependency.

Rule: Safe coordinate mapping, immutable frames and accessible text
Evidence: Negative/coincident/extreme coordinate tests, alias checks and text legend/replay.

Rule: Bounded rendering and deliberate output-file failures
Evidence: Frame/pixel preflight, destination collision and cleanup tests.
